description: Historical observations recovered from project notes. No prompts, raw provider responses, resolved-model metadata, or immutable output captures were retained, so these statements are context only and must not be scored as replay evidence.

observations.summary: The free router sometimes selected role-incompatible terms, including a fork-length field method for catch weight.
Prompt experiments reduced CatchContext over-selection and often produced cleaner catch-count and catch-weight property choices.
This configured model produced the strongest reported core choices but still selected CatchContext where its added value was debatable.

limitations: No raw request or response payloads were retained.
No provider-returned resolved model identifiers were retained.
The historical OpenRouter model aliases may no longer resolve to the same models.
The curated cases-v1 and replay-v1 fixtures are synthetic regression exemplars, not reconstructions of these runs.
